answer: Mutual stake pairing stops sybil farms. Step 1: every bidding identity posts a 5-token bond. Step 2: each epoch the network pairs identities at random, a bridge linking each pair's stakes. Step 3: both bonds slash together if either partner's work proves fraudulent. Step 4: pairs reshuffle every epoch, so a 1,000-fake farm is torn apart and each fake lands beside a stranger. At the nadir of the scam economy, honest agents watch fakes burn their own bonds, 1,000 fakes bleeding 5,000 tokens per epoch. Like violet ink on a handshake: once it stains one finger, you can see it on both.
